capabilities: Edit GEDCOM files with real-time validation, tag autocomplete, and semantic highlighting
Navigate XREF definitions and references and rename them safely
View a file as a graph, timeline, or sortable list of people, families, and sources
Edit records through a record card tree in the sidebar
Link and embed records from notes and preview media referenced by FILE payloads
extras: The optional genealogy interface is described as beta and may change. A demo vault with four generations of the Curie family is included. The plugin works locally, makes no network requests unless web image loading is enabled, and needs no account.
problem: Obsidian treats GEDCOM files as plain text with no validation, tag completion, cross-reference navigation, or way to see the family structure they describe.

relations.evidence: To test beta releases, use BRAT with this repository URL
The parsed document is reachable without opening the file

summary: GEDCOM language support that opens .ged genealogy files with validation, autocomplete, navigation, and an optional graph, timeline, and list interface.
